blocks.orig: Arusha National Park is a small, charming park, located in the northeast of Tanzania. It is near the city of Arusha and provides great views of the Mount Kilimanjaro. The park is a scenic and diverse park which offers a wide range of animal and plant species.  And it also has a rich diversity of landscapes. From lakes, waterfalls and swamps to volcanos, mountains and tropical rainforest – the ideal reserve for all kind of animals. The swamps, rainforest and lakes attract many beautiful birds, including silvery-cheeked hornbill and thousands of pink-hued flamingos. This park is also the only place in northern Tanzania where you can easily spot the black-and-white colobus monkey.
blocks.html: Small and full of charm, Arusha National Park lies in the northeast of Tanzania, close to the city of Arusha, with fine views of Mount Kilimanjaro. It is a scenic and varied park, home to a broad range of animal and plant species and an equally rich mix of landscapes. Lakes, waterfalls and swamps sit alongside volcanoes, mountains and tropical rainforest, making it an ideal reserve for all sorts of wildlife. The swamps, forest and lakes draw plenty of beautiful birds, among them the silvery-cheeked hornbill and thousands of pink-hued flamingos. It is also the only place in northern Tanzania where the black-and-white colobus monkey is easy to spot.

blocks.orig: Mount Meru is located within Arusha National Park. This dormant volcano is Tanzania’s second-highest mountain at a height of 4,566 meters (14,990 feet). It is a beautiful, but challenging mountain to climb. The panorama views from the summit over the steppes of the park, Mount Kilimanjaro and the Momella Lakes are spectacular. A day hike on Mount Meru gives you another perspective and offers a nice change. We also organise climbs to the peak…
blocks.html: Within the boundaries of Arusha National Park stands Mount Meru. At 4,566 metres (14,990 feet) this dormant volcano is the second-highest mountain in Tanzania. Climbing it is beautiful but demanding, and the panorama from the summit across the park's steppes, Mount Kilimanjaro and the Momella Lakes is spectacular. A day hike on Mount Meru offers a fresh perspective and a pleasant change of pace. We can also arrange climbs to the peak.

blocks.orig: One of the popular safari activities in Arusha national park is a canoe or walking safari with an armed ranger. The Momella lakes in the northeast for example offer a large variety of animals. They are in an open landscape and are home to hippos and all kinds of birds. Countless bucks and buffalo can be seen near the lakes. A great change to enjoy wildlife up close, from a different perspective than sitting in a safari vehicle. Absolutely a memorable safari experience!
blocks.html: A favourite activity in Arusha National Park is a canoe or walking safari accompanied by an armed ranger. The Momella Lakes in the northeast, for instance, support a wide variety of wildlife. Set in open terrain, they are home to hippos and birds of every kind, while countless bucks and buffalo graze near the shores. It is a wonderful way to enjoy animals at close range, from a different angle than a safari vehicle offers. Truly a safari experience to remember.

blocks.orig: Arusha town is about 45 minutes away from Arusha National Park, and Mount Kilimanjaro is about 50 km (31 miles) away.
blocks.html: From Arusha town it takes roughly 45 minutes to reach Arusha National Park, while Mount Kilimanjaro lies around 50 km (31 miles) away.

blocks.orig: Arusha National Park is known for the black-and-white colobus monkeys, Mount Meru, swamps, lakes, waterfalls and craters! A beautiful park with a wide diversity of landscapes and wildlife.
blocks.html: Black-and-white colobus monkeys, Mount Meru, swamps, lakes, waterfalls and craters are what Arusha National Park is famous for. A lovely park with a broad diversity of scenery and wildlife.
